title: Looking for Perseida
synopsis: In a future where humanity is extinct, a lone robot crosses a ruined world ruled by evolved dolphins. His mission is not to survive, but to recover a capsule containing the consciousness of Perseida, the woman he loved. To find her, he must cross deserts, wars, and the remains of a civilization that has forgotten what it meant to be human.
awards: Third Prize ($100,000) — Astana AI Film Festival (AAIFF) 2026
